scope: Read the tracked LibreCAD AC1021 source through its detached control-object handles and publish the selected table records.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.relevantRule: For R2007, the object-size field marks the end of object data before the handle references. The LAYER_CONTROL member is a soft-owner reference.

source.provenance: Copied from an already-tracked LibreCAD test fixture. No new DWG or DXF fixture was created.

before.cause: Layer, Style, DimStyle, and VPORT control references were read from the object-data cursor rather than the declared AC1021 handle-stream boundary.

behavior: For AC1021 controls with a nonzero declared object-data size smaller than the frame body, seek the handle cursor to the declared boundary; preserve the exact legacy inline BLOCK_CONTROL and LTYPE_CONTROL routes.
Require the detached AC1021 handle stream to end at the frame boundary with at most seven zero padding bits.
The tracked source regression now requires a complete read and confirms the Layer, Style, DimStyle, and VPORT records at their LibreDWG-observed handles.
A generated LAYER_CONTROL vector rejects nonzero detached-tail padding, resets the model, and accepts the corrected vector using the same DRW_ObjControl instance.

cliReadback.export: refused before output publication because strict completeness is blocked by the retained LTYPE_CONTROL role mismatch

limits: This is one tracked LibreCAD AC1021 writer fixture, not an AutoCAD producer matrix.
The LTYPE BYLAYER role mismatch remains an integrity error and strict DXF output remains refused.
The slice closes no P4-P8 package gate and promotes no format or consumer support claim.
The DWG frame parser completed, but this evidence does not establish native CAD open/save behavior.
nextStep: Continue with the next source-backed, implementation-ready gate; refresh the frozen P8 implementation digest before exact-head CI can qualify this candidate.
